verdict.rationale: Checking application status during review is a fair onboarding question for a business banking and card product like Brex, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a way for a founder to view status on a pending application. The Onboarding API [brex-docs-18] only covers referrals and prefilling signup information, which is an adjacent capability. Community reports describe signups, approvals and rejections but never mention a status-tracking feature.
